description: This file contains the PHP class 'Product' within the namespace 'Opencart.Catalog.Model.Catalog'. The class provides methods for retrieving product data, categories, attributes, and supports various database queries and caching mechanisms. It appears to be part of the model layer of an OpenCart e-commerce system, specifically dealing with catalog products.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents the Product model handling product data retrieval and related operations within the catalog namespace.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific product identified by its product ID, including decoding JSON fields for variant and override data, calculating prices, and reviews.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches a list of products based on provided filter criteria, sorting, and pagination parameters, with caching support.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves categories associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Checks the existence of a product within a specific category by product ID and category ID.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Gathers attributes grouped by attribute group ID for a specific product, including attribute details.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Gets the options for a product, including nested option values, by product ID.

methods.name: getDiscounts
methods.description: Retrieves applicable discounts for a specific product, considering customer group and quantity, with ordering based on quantity, priority, and price.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Fetches images associated with a product, ordered by sort order.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Gets subscription plan details for a product based on a subscription plan ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Fetches all subscription plans associated with a product, including description and status filtering.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the layout ID assigned to a product for a given store; defaults to 0 if none is assigned.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Retrieves related products, including their discount, special, reward, and review information, with caching support.

methods.name: getTotalProducts
methods.description: Counts total products matching filter criteria, with support for category, sub-category, filter, and search queries.

methods.name: getSpecials
methods.description: Retrieves products marked as specials, with filtering by store, customer group, date, and various filters.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Adds a report entry for a product, recording IP, country, and timestamp.
